sources.entry: wechsel - manage bluetooth connections with your keyboard.

summary.one_liner: wechsel is a macOS app for switching Bluetooth connections, such as audio devices, from a global-hotkey Spotlight-like window instead of the built-in Bluetooth menu bar.
summary.what_it_does: The README says wechsel simplifies interacting with Bluetooth connections on macOS by letting you switch between Bluetooth audio devices from the keyboard. A global hotkey opens a Spotlight-style window for this. The README presents it as a more generic alternative to ToothFairy and AirBuddy. It is described as based on the work of blueutil and uses the system IOBluetooth framework. The README does not list further features in detail.
use_cases: switch between audio output devices on mac
quick bluetooth device connect and disconnect
global hotkey launcher for bluetooth devices
how_to_run: Or download the application from the release page on GitHub
If macOS says wechsel.app is damaged: xattr -cr /Applications/wechsel.app
notable: Global hotkey opens a Spotlight-like switcher window
Positioned as a generic alternative to ToothFairy and AirBuddy
Built on blueutil and the system IOBluetooth framework
caveats: Gatekeeper may report the app as damaged, requiring a terminal xattr command to open it
README does not state a license
